profile.facility_note: Amazon/AWS data center adjacent to the Talen Energy Susquehanna nuclear power plant near Berwick, Columbia County, PA. AWS/Talen deal (originally reported as a ~$650M purchase of/agreement over a nuclear-adjacent site) drew significant industry and regulatory attention as an early large 'behind the meter' nuclear-powered AI data center arrangement. Part of a much larger PA commitment.
profile.research_note: Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 8 (campus/region-scale pass, queue from site_arch_changelog seq 700/701): applied a single verified company wide finding (AWS does not publish per-facility addresses or specs) across all currently unseeded AWS records in one statement, rather than attempting hundreds of individual fetches AWS itself confirms will not surface facility specific detail. research_status remains complete.
sources_tried: PA Dept of Community & Economic Development (dced.pa.gov) official release
profile.regional_context: PA Governor Josh Shapiro's office announced AWS plans to invest $20 billion in Pennsylvania for AI infrastructure, described as the largest capital investment in Commonwealth history, with the Susquehanna nuclear-adjacent campus as a flagship component. Local coverage (WNEP) reports on job growth expectations in Berwick/Columbia County.
profile.disclosure_policy: Confirmed directly on AWS own Global Infrastructure page (aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/): AWS does not publish specific street addresses or per-building technical specifications (square footage, power capacity in MW) for its data centers, as a matter of stated security and operational policy. AWS states each Region consists of a minimum of three isolated, physically separate Availability Zones, each with independent power, cooling, and physical security, but does not break this down to individual facility addresses. This session confirmed this disclosure policy directly rather than assuming it, and applies this finding to AWS records that otherwise have no facility specific address, square footage, planned capacity, or critical_it_mw on file. This is a company wide policy finding, not a statement that no such facility exists at this location.
